notes.title: Gold Mining Simulator 2 – Devlog #2
notes.content:
[h2]Devlog #2 is here – and it’s a big one.🔥[/h2][p]
 We’re looking back at the road we’ve traveled so far in building [b]Gold Mining Simulator 2[/b] – and let’s just say, it’s been one hell of a dig.

At the core of it all? A massive upgrade to [b]Unreal Engine 5[/b]. And it changes everything.

[/p][h1]Check out the devlog now! 👇[/h1][p][/p][previewyoutube="qw1Dq6Jxd5o;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
[/p][h3][b]This devlog marks a major milestone[/b] – and it’s only the beginning. [/h3][p]Next devlogs explaining each part of GMS2 world will be coming soon! Because each of these elements deserves a separate devlog!!! 💪
What you see is currently a work in progress and things may change in the full release. In this devlog we wanted to put ephasis on the main differences between old project on UE4 and what the new team achieved in UE5 so far.

[/p][h3]You’ll get a first look at:[/h3][p] 🟡 [b]Stunning new visuals[/b] – Alaska’s raw wilderness has never looked better
 🟡 [b]A reborn Falcon Creek[/b] – from forgotten outpost to bustling hub
 🟡 [b]A brand-new vehicle system[/b] – smoother, smarter, more satisfying
 🟡 [b]Digging that feels right[/b] – powerful, responsive, and deeply rewarding
 🟡 [b]A cleaner, more customizable UI [/b]– stay focused on what matters
 🟡 [b]A living world[/b] – you're not the only one out here
 🟡 [b]Machines[/b] - so detailed, even the bolts got love

 [/p][h3]📜 While you are waiting for the release, give Gold Mining Simulator a try![/h3][p]

notes.title: Welcome to Gold Mining Simulator 2`s steampage! 👋
notes.content:
Hello, Miners! 👋

With great pleasure we want to welcome you on [b]Gold Mining Simulator 2[/b]’s steam page! Whether you're a seasoned prospector or just starting your journey, get ready to dig deep, refine your techniques, and strike it rich, as Gold Mining Simulator is coming to a different level - [b]this time, with your friends in a multiplayer mode[/b]! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29258259/4bc83c527494628b284cba19485869e185becdc6.png[/img]

[h3]What's coming with Gold Mining Simulator 2? 📢 [/h3] 
We aim to create GMS 2 [b]with passion and respect[/b] to all of our fans - what's the most important, the game will be [b]based on the analyzed feedback of our playerbase[/b]. With the strong base of the already existing Gold Mining Simulator, we want to meet your expectations and add our own ideas. 

[h3]What has happened so far? 📅 [/h3]
Since the new team joined the company at the end of 2023 and took over the project, we have [b]switched the engine from UE4 to UE5[/b]. 💥 This took a considerable amount of time, but it was necessary, as we want to [b]support the game for a long time and expand it with future expansions[/b]! 🎁 We've also added a new map, NPCs, sidequests, changed approach to Gold support and communication. 🏆

[h3]Communication 💬 [/h3]
[b]Communication with our player is the most important factor for us[/b]. We want to communicate [b]directly and frequently[/b], which is why we’ve hired a new Community Manager specifically for the players. There will be plenty of [b]devlogs[/b] about the game's development as well! If you want to be a part of the game's development, give us feedback and ideas and talk to the devs directly - [url=https://discord.gg/goldminingsimulator]join our Discord[/url].
📢 The German player base has a significant percentage share in GMS 1. We appreciate it, and from now on, all news will also be available in German! 📢

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KzFk8BzDCPY][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29258259/5207273f881e65d6e349c8b3810b6b720b91b083.png[/img][/url]

[b]🎬 Join our live Q&A stream on YouTube[/b] (03.02 at 17:00 CET) to discuss the Steam page, trailer, and your questions! You cannot miss this! 

Don’t forget to add the game to your [b]Steam wishlist[/b] - it will let us know that you’re really hyped about it, and above all, will let you be up to date with everything related to GMS2! 

You can sign up for the playtests now on Steam - please note, that they are not starting right away. After signing up you will be notified once they start, so stay tuned for the annoucenements. There may be more playtests in the future - let’s see how it goes!

In the meantime, don't forget that you can play Gold Mining Simulator NOW! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/451340/Gold_Mining_Simulator/
